thread:
ashok: seeing 503s from apiserver in eu-central1 during a big GPU onboarding. controller-manager restarts spiking, etcd leader flipped a couple times. anyone looking? cc @maria :eyes:
ops-bot: ALERT: apiserver 5xx rate spike detected at 2026-03-20T08:12Z — 5xx/sec 90 -> 420. metrics: http://metrics/apiserver?range=1h
maria: on it, grabbing events + etcd leader history. do we know which pool is onboarding?
sam: looks like "gpu-eu-central-accelerate" batch provisioning (~120 nodes started at 08:10). snippets:
```
etcd: raft: leader 10.2.1.4 stepped down -> new leader 10.2.1.9 (term 5)
apiserver: 503 returned for /api/v1/namespaces, errors spike, client timeouts to etcd
```
leo: saw a big attach I/O surge on NVMe in the region earlier. attach/volume ops were peaking and kubelets were hitting apiserver for cloud-provider auth and attach status. combined with a small etcd quorum jitter this amplifies 5xxs.
ashok: controller-manager restart count went 3 -> 18 in ~20m, logs show repeated reconcile timeouts:
```
E0319 08:13:12 controller-runtime: reconcile failed: context deadline exceeded
```
maria: temporary mitigations: cordon the new nodes and pause the provisioner. also suggest throttling attach requests at the provisioner to ~10/s to smooth the fanout.
sam: quick metric dump: p90 apiserver token auth latency 1.2s -> 9.8s, etcd leader sync wait climbed to 4s. if we pause onboarding the pressure should drop fast.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout 'gpu-provisioner:v2.3.1' finished at 08:09 — coincident but not obviously causal.
leo: runbook suggestion:
1) cordon new nodes: `kubectl cordon <node>`
2) bump controller-manager CPU from 200m -> 800m (temp)
3) set provisioner flag `--max-attach-per-sec=10` and restart provisioner
4) if persistence, increase etcd election timeout by a small delta temporarily
ashok: @maria can you cordon + apply throttle? i'll bump controller-manager CPU and watch etcd. :thumbsup:
maria: cordoned nodes gpu-eu-1-{a..d}, patched provisioner flag and restarted. controller-manager CPU bumped on staging, patching prod in 2m. monitoring shows 5xx rate dropping to ~120 now.
sam: confirming p95 apiserver latency down to ~2.1s and etcd leader stable. will keep an eye for 30m.
leo: follow-up: we need a pre-provisioning policy to rate-limit attach fanouts and a postmortem with cost/impact analysis. pls file infra backlog ticket.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 created and assigned to eng-sre. SLA window: 4h.
